title: Two men convicted in France over the death of a Kick ‘humiliation streamer.’
summary: The New York Times reports that Owen Cenazandotti and Safine Hamadi were convicted of aggravated violence, incitement to hatred, and violence online related to Raphaël Graven’s death during a Kick livestream last year .
